name: Tracker
description: A row of coloured activity segments, each with a hover tooltip.

fields.fine: ThemedColor? - fill of a fine segment
fields.warning: ThemedColor? - fill of a warning segment
fields.critical: ThemedColor? - fill of a critical segment (destructive token)
fields.unknown: ThemedColor? - fill of an unknown segment (mutedForeground token)

notes: The old `TrackerLevel` abstract class with four `static const` instances is one enum; its per-level literal `Color` moved into `TrackerTheme` as a `ThemedColor` row, so a preset switch restyles the tracker.
Each literal status colour is a `TrackerTheme` field (`fine` / `warning`), so Studio can edit it; `critical` and `unknown` are token refs.
The old `TrackerThemeDefaults` (radius 6 / gap 2 / height 32) was never read by the widget; the defaults now feed the resolver.
The old widget wrapped its tooltip content in a `TooltipContainer` on top of the one the tooltip already applied; the segment passes the bare tooltip widget now.
